subject: PO handoff & invoice schedule for Mosaic Health - commit checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO handoff & invoice schedule for Mosaic Health - commit checklist

Team,

Following our deal desk call this morning for Mosaic Health (DEAL-4782), I'm pulling together the items we need to hold to the Q3 bookings recognition window. High level: Mosaic's procurement indicated they can submit a PO but we're tight on their fiscal cutoff. To make bookings recognize in the upcoming quarter we need the following in place by the dates noted below. Please reply with a single-line owner for any items you pick up.

Critical items & target dates:
- Signed SOW (sales) — target: 2027-04-25
- Customer PO (procurement) — target submission: 2027-04-28 (Mosaic asked this date)
- Billing contact + bank/ACH details (customer) — needed by 2027-04-28
- Invoice issue date / invoice blocks (finance) — need to confirm by 2027-04-29 to hit recognition window
- HubSpot deal stage locked to Commit by 2027-04-29 (sales ops)

Notes:
- If PO arrives after May 2 (Mosaic fiscal cutoff), recognition will roll to next bookings period.
- Finance is open to issuing a pro-forma invoice to expedite payment processing, but we need sign-off on the SOW and a clear billing instruction from the customer.

Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.pdf (fillable template I use), draft invoice cadence stub.

Suggested owners (volunteer please):
- SOW finalization: Rachel (I will own edits and send back to customer)
- PO follow-up: Vanessa (can you lead procurement thread?)
- Invoice issuance & dates: Marissa (finance)
- HubSpot stage commit: Ben

I'll loop in Mosaic procurement once owners confirm. Thanks — short replies here are fine.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

I'll draft the message and copy you.

Subject: Re: PO handoff & invoice schedule for Mosaic Health - commit checklist

Vanessa / Rachel — thanks for the clear list. Procurement here: we can raise a PO but need an approved SOW and your vendor form completed. Our expected internal submission date for the PO is 2027-04-28 (we're targeting this but cannot promise earlier).

Constraints to flag:
- Mosaic's fiscal processing window closes on 2027-05-02 for this month; if the PO isn't in our system before that date it will likely fall to next period.
- We can accept a pro-forma or pre-invoice to start vendor set up, but final invoice needs the PO number.

Attached: Mosaic_PO_Form.pdf (our procurement template).

If you can provide the signed SOW and a pro-forma invoice by 04/26, we should be able to get the PO into our system on 04/28. Please confirm whether Redwood can issue a pro-forma invoice dated 2027-05-01 in the absence of the PO, and whether finance will accept that for initial bookkeeping.

Regards,
Sara Linden
Senior Procurement Manager | Mosaic Health
procurement@mosaichealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:54:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO handoff & invoice schedule for Mosaic Health - commit checklist

On Apr 19, 2027, Sara Linden <sara.linden@mosaichealth.com> wrote:
> If you can provide the signed SOW and a pro-forma invoice by 04/26, we should be able to get the PO into our system on 04/28.

We can accept a pro-forma invoice for vendor onboarding purposes, but per policy the final invoice must reference the customer PO to recognize revenue. Practical plan:

1) Rachel to get signed SOW by 2027-04-25 (sales) — we'll prepare a pro-forma invoice the same day.
2) Once Mosaic confirms PO number (target 04/28), we'll issue the official invoice dated 2027-05-01 and move to booking recognition for the quarter.
3) If PO arrives after 2027-05-02, bookings recognition will be deferred — please flag to the revenue ops channel immediately.

Action items assigned:
- Rachel: finalize SOW (due 04/25)
- Vanessa: follow up with Mosaic procurement and confirm PO submission cadence (due 04/22 initial check-in)
- Ben: update HubSpot deal stage to Commit once SOW is signed and pro-forma is sent (due 04/26)
- Marissa (Finance): will hold tentative invoice date 2027-05-01 pending PO number; will mark revenue hold if PO misses cutoff.

Attachment: proforma-invoice-draft.pdf (I've drafted a minimal pro-forma to match Mosaic's fields).

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

- I will finalize and return the signed SOW by 2027-04-25 (owner: Rachel).
- Marissa will issue the pro-forma invoice on 2027-04-26 to help you with vendor onboarding.
- Mosaic to submit formal PO by 2027-04-28 (owner: Mosaic procurement).
- Finance will issue the final invoice dated 2027-05-01 once PO number is provided; if PO arrives after 2027-05-02 then recognition will be deferred.

Ben — please set the HubSpot deal to Commit after I send the signed SOW (target 04/26). Vanessa — please confirm you have the PO template attached when you reach back out to procurement.

I'll drop a short summary into the Deal record and attach the SOW/pro-forma when complete: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456/DEAL-4782
